assumptions: Each enzyme's site and cut offsets are REBASE's; every site is cut.
limits: Complete digestion is assumed: partials are not modelled.
Fragment ends are as the enzymes leave them; no end treatment is applied.
bio.jane/contract.question: Which fragments, with which ends, does a digest of this molecule produce?

description: Digest the subject with the given enzymes into real fragments (sequence + both overhangs). Emits the selected fragment as a NEW record, so a downstream gel/map/ORF runs on that fragment — the digest→assembly hand-off.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

enzymes.description: enzymes to digest with — resolved against the bundled cut catalog (REBASE spellings; smaller than the REBASE dossier the editor shows). Left unset, the run uses your active enzyme collection.

fragment_index.description: which fragment to emit as the downstream record (0-based, in cut order).

name: digest_fragments

parentSpan.description: where the emitted fragment sat on the parent, [start, end). A start above the end spans the origin

record.description: the selected fragment as a linear record
